'''Nolem Coe''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] who became a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] within the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> the separatists allied themselves with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]]. Nolem Coe was killed by Republic forces that repelled the Hidden Chain's [[raid on Kessan's Landing]].<ref name="TOR" />
